prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation extension of an ADOPTED pixel game character, not a redesign. The attached sheet is the approved design and poses at nearest 4x; use its first standing pose as exact identity, palette, scale and proportions. Same adopted compact, unhurried indigo ninja. Completely opaque hood with NO eyes, eye slit, bright dots, mouth or visible facial skin. Small topknot, gray forearm/shin wraps. Body ~34 native pixels tall. Relaxed breezy and cold, not angry muscular.
Create only these NEW motion poses: 4 columns x 2 rows. Top row four distinct alternating swift walking phases, compact limbs, calm upper body. Bottom row (4) short alive hit flinch, (5) recovery, (6) right arm drawing back for dagger thrust with EMPTY gripping hand, (7) empty gripping hand extended in a short horizontal dagger thrust. Dagger is supplied separately later, no baked weapon or star. All facing RIGHT. No smoke or magic.
Transparent RGBA background, equal grid cells, generous transparent gutters, consistent full-body scale and ground baseline, complete feet and limbs. Clean chunky square pixel clusters for a small game sprite enlarged into the output, same muted palette, 1-pixel native dark brown contour, upper-left illumination. No smooth airbrushed illustration, no labels/grid/text/background/ground shadows/additional people. Same head and face in every cell. Meaningful limb changes, never just translated duplicates. Output only the motion sheet.
